In addition, it should be cognitively accessible and minimize users’ physical efforts. Finally, it requires the providing of sufficient space for all users while reducing potential hazards and adverse consequences from accidental or unintended actions. A key feature of universal design is that this is not a special requirement only for the benefit of a minority of the population.
